name: Battery charge
oneLiner: a big glass battery drifts in 3D, a metal plug slides into its terminal with a click and a spark, the liquid fill climbs from red through amber to green with a sheen running across it while the bolt pulses and the percent counts, then it hits 100: the battery bounces, a green ring of light pulses off it and the label flips to Fully charged
say: when the speaker talks about energy or being recharged ('this gives me my energy back', 'it fully charges your week'): the plug clicks on the setup, 100 lands on the payoff
